limitations: Everbridge rows are the county's tabulated record of each launched notification (send time with seconds, message issue time as written in the message text, total contacts). They show messages launched to registered contact paths, not receipt, departure or compliance. AAR rows are a retrospective official timeline compiled from interviews and debriefs; times are clock minutes as written and describe when something was reported or done, not necessarily when a physical state began. Rows with time_precision 'day' are untimed narrative statements about December 30 and must not be treated as instants.
OSM is community mapped and may omit roads or 2021 access restrictions.
Service roads and private/no-access ways are excluded.
Unknown directional lane counts and speeds remain null; nothing is inferred.
Exit nodes are geometric bbox crossings; destination names are unknown.
The bbox was queried as four tiles; ways crossing tile edges are merged by OSM ID after an equality check.

untimed_facts: Trailhead Fire ignited roughly one hour after the Eldorado Springs Fire (investigative summary p. 6); no clock time published.
The two fires merged; investigators did not determine when or where (investigative summary p. 2).
